plain.li: [killed] {NAME} swore vengeance on {FACTION} for {OTHER_nameDef}.
[killed] Over {OTHER_nameDef}'s body, {NAME} swore that {FACTION} would pay.
[killed] {NAME} won't forget {OTHER_nameDef}, and won't forgive {FACTION}.
[killed,kin,!many] {NAME} lost family to {FACTION} today, and has sworn to make them pay for {OTHER_nameDef}.
[killed,partner,!many] {NAME} closed {OTHER_nameDef}'s eyes and swore that {FACTION} would pay for it.
[killed,friend,!many] {OTHER_nameDef} was {NAME}'s friend. {FACTION} will find that out.
[killed,many] {NAME} stood together over {OTHER_nameDef} and swore the same oath against {FACTION}.
[killed,mech] {NAME} swore to tear apart three of the machines for every year {OTHER_nameDef} should have had.
[taken,!many] {FACTION} carried off {OTHER_nameDef}, and {NAME} means to make them pay.
[taken] {NAME} watched {FACTION} drag {OTHER_nameDef} away, and swore they'd regret it.
[taken,many] {NAME} have sworn to make {FACTION} answer for taking {OTHER_nameDef}.
[taken,partner,!many] {FACTION} took {OTHER_nameDef} from {NAME}'s side, and {NAME} has sworn they'll pay for it.
[pet] {FACTION} killed {OTHER_nameDef} in the fighting, and {NAME} has sworn they'll pay for it.
[pet] {NAME} knelt by {OTHER_nameDef} after the fighting and swore that {FACTION} would answer for it.

warm.li: [killed,!many] {NAME} has never wanted to hurt anyone, but for {OTHER_nameDef}'s sake has sworn to make an exception of {FACTION}.
[pet] {NAME} held {OTHER_nameDef} until the end, and swore then that {FACTION} would answer for it.

blunt.li: [killed,!many] {FACTION} killed {OTHER_nameDef}. {NAME} is going to kill some of them back.
[taken,!many] {FACTION} took {OTHER_nameDef}. {NAME} wants them to try that again.
[pet] They killed {NAME}'s animal. {FACTION} picked the wrong fight.

gloomy.li: [killed,!many] {NAME} says vengeance won't bring {OTHER_nameDef} back, and has sworn it on {FACTION} anyway.

cold.li: [killed,!many] {NAME} has added {FACTION} to a short list, with {OTHER_nameDef}'s name beside it.
[taken,!many] {NAME} has begun keeping count of what {FACTION} owes for {OTHER_nameDef}.

plain.li: [blood] {PAWN_nameDef} has avenged {LOST} on {FACTION}.
[blood] {FACTION} has paid {PAWN_nameDef} what it owed for {LOST}, in full.
[blood,pet] {PAWN_nameDef} has paid {FACTION} back for {LOST}, and finally put the empty collar away.
[captive] {PAWN_nameDef} has settled with {FACTION} over {LOST}, some of it in blood and some of it in chains.
[captive] {PAWN_nameDef} says the ones taken alive count as much as the dead. The debt for {LOST} is paid.
[home] {LOST} is home, and {PAWN_nameDef} has no quarrel left with {FACTION}.
[home] {PAWN_nameDef} met {LOST} at the gate and didn't let go for a long while. Whatever {FACTION} owed, it can keep.
[forgiven] {PAWN_nameDef} has laid down the vendetta against {FACTION}. {LOST} wouldn't have wanted {PAWN_objective} to carry it forever.
[forgiven] {PAWN_nameDef} woke up one morning and found the hatred for {FACTION} gone, though {PAWN_pronoun} still misses {LOST}.
[forgiven,pet] {PAWN_nameDef} has let the matter of {LOST} go. Animals don't hold grudges, {PAWN_nameDef} says, and {LOST} never did.
[peace] With peace made, {PAWN_nameDef} has decided to stop counting what {FACTION} owes for {LOST}.
[peace] Now that there's peace, {PAWN_nameDef} finds {PAWN_pronoun} has nothing left to say to {FACTION} about {LOST}.

warm.li: [forgiven] {PAWN_nameDef} lit a candle for {LOST} and let the anger at {FACTION} go out with the old one.
[home] {PAWN_nameDef} is too happy to have {LOST} back to remember why {FACTION} mattered.

blunt.li: [forgiven] {PAWN_nameDef} is done with {FACTION}. Hating them was getting tiring.

gloomy.li: [blood] {PAWN_nameDef} has had {PAWN_possessive} revenge on {FACTION} for {LOST}, and says it feels like less than expected.
[forgiven] {PAWN_nameDef} has stopped hating {FACTION}. {LOST} is still gone; the hating never changed that.

cold.li: [blood] {PAWN_nameDef} has closed the account with {FACTION} for {LOST}.
[peace] {PAWN_nameDef} has judged a feud with {FACTION} no longer worth the cost, and dropped it.

plain.li: I don't hate {FACTION} any more. I looked for it this morning and it wasn't there.
I told {LOST} at the grave that I'm letting it go. It felt like being forgiven myself.
[peace] Their traders came through today and I said good morning to them. {LOST}, I hope that was all right.
[pet] {LOST} never held a grudge in its life. I'm trying to learn that from it, late.

warm.li: I'm putting it down, the anger at {FACTION}. I'd rather carry {LOST}'s memory than their weight.

cheerful.li: I laughed today, properly, for the first time since {LOST}. I think that means I'm done with {FACTION}.

gloomy.li: Let it go, they said. I have. {LOST} is still gone.

cold.li: The feud with {FACTION} served no further purpose. I've ended it.

plain.li: {LOST} is home. I don't care about {FACTION} any more. I don't care about anything except that.
I kept my promise to find {LOST}. Or {LOST} found us. It doesn't matter which.

warm.li: {LOST} is home and eating at our table again. I keep looking over to make sure.

cheerful.li: {LOST} IS HOME. I'm writing it in big letters so I'll remember how this felt.

gloomy.li: {LOST} is back, but quieter. Whatever {FACTION} did, it will take a while.

cold.li: {LOST} has returned. The account with {FACTION} is closed.

plain.li: [pet] {FACTION} killed {OTHER_nameDef} in the fighting. It only ever wanted to be near me. I won't forget who did it.
[pet] There's an empty place by my bed where {OTHER_nameDef} slept. {FACTION} made it empty.

blunt.li: [pet] {FACTION} killed my animal. Next time they come, I'm first out the gate.

gloomy.li: [pet] People will say it was only an animal. {OTHER_nameDef} was more than that, and {FACTION} knows it now too.

plain.li: [captive] Not all of them died. One of them is in our cells now, and I find that's enough for {LOST}.
[captive] I took one of {FACTION} alive today. I thought I'd want them dead. I just wanted them to stop.
[pet] {FACTION} paid for {LOST}. I went and sat where {LOST} used to sleep, and told it so.

cold.li: [captive] One of {FACTION} is in a cell because of me. The ledger for {LOST} is balanced.
